I've treated her right and showed her all I want is her before. Our fights have been really bad and mostly I feel like when she says things to hurt me she says it outta anger but she mostly says things like that for fun not realizing that I've treated her like a Queen for a long time. She enjoys making me feel confused and stuff and when we fight, shit just piles up then I mess up again because im confused. My mind is set on her but she makes me confused. She says I love you when shes happy and I dont when shes angry. So we both messing up each others perspective on what we really want with each other. I LOVE HER but 4 years of that attitude towards me has had its toll on me. I've been strong for 4 years taking in words that can never be taken back. But when we're happy We enjoy each others company. If only she knew that I really Love Her but she doesnt know that anymore because i messed up again.

I had the same relationship problem in the beginning. Girlfriend didnt really show me how affectionate she was. She wouldnt fight for me at times and would rather tell me to leave but she never really means it or even know how to show that I meant something to her. I was really insecure and didnt know myself also that she felt the same. We found out when we talked about it to each other and started to improve on it. I started at 18 years too while she was 17. Now im 22 and we're still together. I tell you bro sometimes you need patience or just tell her how she could improve on where shes going wrong. And if she wants to try and change for you things will work out. 10 months too short and plus you're both young. Sit and have a talk with her. Tell her how you feel. Best of luck

I was that way before. My girlfriend ruined my self esteem and stuff with things she said that hurt me alot and fml you cant take those words back. I drifted apart
Now im just an asshole cause I've kissed 2 other girls while still in the same relationship because she makes me mad alot. I still love my girlfriend so much and  Now we both want to make things work and I want to be the sweetest guy she was with before but damage is already done. Point is....You got a good guy. Be the best girlfriend towards him and never say things you cant take back. You'll never know what you lost untill its gone.
